verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents an official `cafe` CLI that signs you in, sets up Git credentials, and manages repositories, pull requests, stacks and issues from the terminal. It is built for agent use: `--json` gives structured output, `--no-input` fails instead of prompting, `--yes` confirms destructive actions, and `cafe api` gives authenticated access to any REST endpoint. It also offers stack submission across Git, jj and Sapling, agent skills extend the same workflow to coding assistants, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use.
